What do these settings mean?

T is the peak-torque operating reference; P is the rated-power reference. Both include tooth loading and centrifugal force. The five saved mixtures use a + b = 1 and T share λ = a / (a + b).

All layouts shown have five openings, 200 mm pitch diameter, 30 mm face width and 30 mm bore. The steel reference uses E = 210 GPa and yield strength 695 MPa. These controls select saved results; they do not run a new FE analysis.

How are material comparisons calculated?

For the same geometry, force loads, Poisson ratio and density, changing a uniform elastic modulus changes displacement but leaves the linear-elastic stress solution unchanged. Static factors scale by yield strength divided by 695 MPa; fatigue factors scale by effective fatigue amplitude divided by 277.726295 MPa. Retention ratios stay unchanged. The study uses Poisson ratio 0.3, density 7,800 kg/m³, an amplitude factor of 0.8 and the same Findley parameter interval for comparison.

These are homogeneous material calculations, not additional material-specific FE validation. Published specimen data are research examples, not production design allowables; a carburized case/core gradient, residual stress and manufacturing effects require separate evidence. The original reference retains its inherited research amplitude.

Coverage and verification scope
TeethStatic rowsFatigue rowsEvidence role

Each record is authenticated against its archived source and retains the original normalization or explicit reconstruction method. The wider numerical package passed its retained-summary replay and source checks. This is not a claim that every original raw field was solved again or experimentally validated.

Reconstructed development values can use a regenerated matching control where stated; this does not establish identity to unrecovered historical arrays. No missing response is filled by interpolation. Materials are compared using the conditional homogeneous calculation in the main explorer, not presented as a complete matrix of independent tooth-count/material tests.
